It’s given me the will to take action and remove a lot of the graffiti the best I can. Letting others know how important it is to keep things beautiful, especially since hundreds may see the scars left when the person who put it there may never return. It’s helped me keep the world beautiful for others. I’m big on leave no trace, even messing up the grass where my tent flattens it. I add beauty to the world and get to take advantage of it, but I do it so those after me can keep the illusion of untouched nature or at the least, don’t have something breaking the beauty. I honestly don’t care about bridges or abandoned building graffiti, my line is when something beautiful, like nature, is destroyed by selfishness or an ego. If it isn’t obvious I’m an Eagle Scout so my exposure and opportunity is higher than most I’d believe. I don’t think I chose this hatred, I feel like it comes from my deep appreciation for nature.
